why: Both land on essentially the same hedgehog (branded absorbent consumer products, profit per consumer brand) and cover all the key brutal facts, with Analysis 2 slightly closer on stop-doing because it exits the whole paper class including tobacco papers plus aviation services. Analysis 1 is the better hand-off for an already-great subject: it explicitly names the company as already great, runs in stewardship mode with a short list of real temptations, and gives a tighter one-screen verdict, whereas Analysis 2 never recognises the greatness and piles on eight stop-doing items.
